title: The exponential structural bound needs the actual full weighted gain ledger
statement: For commuting defects B_x, M=sum B_x and V=exp(theta M), the actual source-resolved table proves R^*V<=0 and SEAL_x^*V=-mu_x(1-exp(-theta))B_x V. Singleton drifts alone would not imply this. Local joint-cb noise adds at most C_theta eta N V. With k=mu(1-exp(-theta))/theta, log Tr(V rho_t) <= e^-kt log Tr(V rho_0)+(C_theta eta N/k)(1-e^-kt). An admitted initial moment and small noise give a fixed-time excessive-density bound uniform in time, not a no-event-ever or semantic-correctness theorem.
